name: Kilo Code CLI
disclaimer: Written from the documented interface, not verified against an install. Flags drift; correct and open a PR.
notes: An opencode fork (Kilo-Org/kilocode, npm @kilocode/cli). The command is kilo, with kilocode as an alias.

resume.note: the CLI page says --continue takes neither a prompt nor --auto while the generated reference lists both under kilo run; resume by id instead

options.trust_none_note: the ask agent blocks every write
options.trust_all_note: without --auto a non-interactive run refuses every permission request

transcript.access: READ-ONLY. A second writer corrupts the agent's own state.
